description.value: Hi-nippon is a neighbourhood Japanese restaurant in Kitsilano sitting on West 4th Avenue, one of Vancouver's primary east–west cycling corridors. The menu spans traditional Japanese staples — sashimi, nigiri, gyoza, karaage, and a broad appetizer list — with catering available for events. Its position between downtown and UBC, combined with sit-down dining and online ordering, makes it a convenient and substantive meal stop for touring cyclists passing through.
